description: Full happy path for a customer (PER-001) reporting APP fraud via mobile app. Payment has been made; customer reports fraud within hours. Investigation completed. Full reimbursement approved and credited within 5 business days. Recovery claim raised against receiving PSP.

steps.label: Selects suspect payment, submits fraud report
steps.note: Customer navigates to 'Report Fraud' in mobile app, selects transaction from history

steps.label: POST /fraud-cases (customer_id, account_id, payment_intent_id, trigger_type=customer_report)
Create FraudCase (ENT-043), status=open. Publish FraudCaseCreated (EVT-090)
201 Created — FraudCase {case_id, case_reference, status=open}
Case reference APP-20260415-000123 confirmed. Decision within 5 business days.
Dispatch FraudCaseCreated notification (push + email) to PER-001
GET /fraud-cases/{id} — open case from analyst queue
Publish FraudDataRequested (payment_intent_id) → Event Bus [cross-capability async: CAP-004→CAP-001, CAP-004→CAP-003]
steps.note: Cross-capability boundary enforced. SVC-013 (CAP-004) must not call SVC-001 (CAP-001) or SVC-009 (CAP-003) synchronously. Event Bus (SVC-102) mediates the request.

steps.label: SVC-001 consumes FraudDataRequested — retrieves PaymentIntent (cop_result, fraud_score, cop_override_confirmed) and Customer data
Publish FraudDataProvided (payment_intent_id, amount=£12500, cop_result=match, fraud_risk_level=medium, cop_override_confirmed=false, customer metadata)
SVC-009 consumes FraudDataRequested — retrieves PaymentExecution (fps_reference, settlement_status, receiving_sort_code)
Publish FraudPaymentExecutionProvided (fps_reference=FPS20260410000001, settlement_status=settled, receiving_sort_code=200000)
SVC-013 consumes FraudDataProvided and FraudPaymentExecutionProvided — hydrates FraudCase with evidence data
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=transaction_data, source_reference={payment_intent_id})
Create FraudEvidence records (transaction_data, cop_result). PATCH FraudCase status=investigating. Publish FraudInvestigationStarted (EVT-091)
Dispatch FraudInvestigationStarted notification (secure in-app message) to PER-001
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=device_data — device fingerprint and behavioural biometrics consistent with normal customer behaviour)
PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (vulnerability_assessment=[elderly], vulnerability_detail='Customer 78 years old')
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=vulnerability_assessment_record, psr_relevance=supports_eligibility)
PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (status=decision_pending)
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/decision (decision=approve, reimbursement_amount=12500, decision_rationale='...')
Validate decision. Update FraudCase (status=reimbursed, decision_outcome=approved, reimbursement_amount=12500). Publish FraudReimbursementApproved (EVT-092)
Dispatch regulated outcome letter (approve) to PER-001 — push notification + email
Consume FraudReimbursementApproved (EVT-092). Credit £12,500 to Account {account_id}. Debit APP fraud loss suspense account. Publish ReimbursementCredited (EVT-094)
steps.note: P99 < 30 minutes from event receipt to credit applied

steps.label: Dispatch credit confirmation notification to PER-001: '£12,500 credited — Case APP-20260415-000123'
Push notification: '£12,500 APP Fraud Reimbursement credited to your account'
Consume FraudReimbursementApproved (EVT-092). Create ReimbursementClaim (ENT-045): sending_bank_share=£6,250, receiving_bank_share=£6,250, receiving_sort_code=200000
Submit reimbursement recovery claim to Pay.UK (receiving_bank_share=£6,250, fps_reference, receiving_sort_code)
Pay.UK claim reference assigned: PAYUK-CLAIM-20260415-001. Claim status: pending
Update ReimbursementClaim (pay_uk_claim_reference set). Publish RecoveryInitiated (EVT-095)
[~15 business days later] Receiving PSP returns £6,250. Pay.UK notifies sending bank.
steps.note: Recovery timeline is independent of the 5-day customer reimbursement SLA

steps.label: Update ReimbursementClaim (recovery_status=full, recovery_amount=6250, recovery_resolved_at=...). Publish RecoveryCompleted (EVT-096)
PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (status=closed)
Set FraudCase.closed_at. Publish FraudCaseClosed (EVT-097). Publish FraudPatternDetected (EVT-098) with anonymised pattern features. PSR quarterly counter incremented.
Archive FraudCase + FraudEvidence records to WORM store (7-year retention)
Dispatch case closure notification to PER-001

timing_checkpoints.sla: FraudCase.reimbursement_date must be <= 5 business days from reported_date (NFR-005-REG-001)
